ROOT_CAUSE: The introduction/context regex matches the phrase "I'm <<talking about>>" because the pattern allows lowercase words and arbitrary verb phrases following "I'm", while failing to match capitalized multi-word names due to overly restrictive or misaligned group boundaries.
RULE: Name regex patterns must strictly enforce capitalization (e.g., `[A-Z]`) on all name tokens and exclude common conversational verb phrases like "talking about".
NEXT_EDIT: Refine the introduction pattern from `\b(?:my name is|I am|I'm|This is|hey its)\s+([A-Za-zà-öø-ÿ]+(?:\s+[A-Za-zà-öø-ÿ]+){1,3})\b` to require capitalized words `[A-Z][a-zà-öø-ÿ]+` and explicitly exclude verb phrases.
